name: Harmonic Drive Systems Inc.
fiscal_year_note: Fiscal year ends March 31. Current year FY3/27 = Apr 2026 to Mar 2027 (company MTP calls it fiscal 2026). Q1 (Apr-Jun 2026) was released Aug 7, 2026 at 16:00 JST. H1 (Q2) results are expected around mid-November 2026 (prior year: Nov 12, 2025). Japanese GAAP. Overseas subsidiaries appear to be consolidated with a 3-month lag (Q1 FX rates match Jan-Mar averages).
full_year_guidance: FY3/27, raised Aug 7, 2026: net sales JPY 74.5bn (+25.1%; prior 68.0), operating profit JPY 8.5bn (11.4% margin; prior 6.2), ordinary profit JPY 8.2bn (prior 6.2), net profit JPY 6.0bn (prior 4.5), EPS JPY 63.38 (prior 47.54). H1 forecast: sales JPY 35.7bn, OP JPY 3.7bn, NP JPY 2.7bn. DPS JPY 20. FX assumptions: JPY 156.59/USD, 179.76/EUR, 22.52/CNY (prior 147.50, 170.00, 20.75). Plans: capex JPY 6.6bn (+37.6%), R&D JPY 4.0bn, D&A JPY 7.1bn. FY2030 medium-term targets (as summarized by FilingReader): sales above JPY 100bn, OP margin above 15%, ROIC/ROE above 10%.
fx_sensitivity: No per-yen sensitivity disclosed. Q1 FY3/27 FX lifted operating profit by about JPY 269m (yen weaker vs EUR by about 14%, USD about 3%, CNY about 8% at the rates used). Our rough inference: about JPY 0.1bn of annual OP per 1% broad yen move, i.e. about 1.4% of the FY OP guide. Largest exposure is EUR via Harmonic Drive SE (Germany, about 28% of Q1 sales), then USD via the US subsidiary (about 18%). Guidance already assumes JPY 156.59/USD, close to spot.

physical_ai_exposure.description: Makes strain wave gears (HarmonicDrive), planetary reducers and mechatronic actuators used in robot joints; Toyo Keizai (Mar 2026) puts its share of the global small precision reducer market at 80-90%. A humanoid robot may use 6-10x as many reducers as a conventional industrial robot. 'AI robots' is a separate application category: in Nov 2025 the company said it was handling inquiries from about 15 AI-robot companies, one North American startup had moved to mass production, and it had started expanding North American capacity for AI robots. Industrial robots are an estimated ~30% of sales; AI/humanoid robot sales are not disclosed and appear small. Sep 2026: joint development with Riken NPR on next-generation resin strain wave gears.
physical_ai_exposure.optionality_notes: The purest listed humanoid-component play in Japan. The stock ran from JPY 2,420 (Nov 2025 low) to a record JPY 9,150 on Jul 6, 2026 (about 3.8x) and still trades at about 80x forward EPS and 5.9x book. In May 2026 management replaced its medium-term plan because AI-robot adoption is running slower than assumed, while keeping the long-term view. The shares are now JPY 5,090 (-44% from the peak) and react sharply to humanoid news and AI sentiment (-11.6% on Oct 15, -9.6% on Oct 22, 2026).

cost_and_supply_chain_notes: Operating leverage is high: OP margin went from 0.9% in Q1 FY3/26 to 11.0% in Q1 FY3/27 on +23.6% sales, helped by a better marginal profit ratio, partly offset by higher fixed manufacturing costs and SG&A. FY3/26 OP margin was only 4.3%. Capex plan JPY 6.6bn for FY3/27 (FY3/26: 4.8bn). Key inputs are special steels and precision machining capacity; the resin-gear project with Riken NPR aims at lighter, cheaper gears. Production sites (general knowledge, not verified this session): Japan (Nagano), Germany (Harmonic Drive SE, Limburg) and the US subsidiary (Massachusetts), which limits US tariff exposure for US-built product. The Q1 presentation reports Harmonic Drive SE sales +26.4%, US subsidiary +12.5%, China sales subsidiary -17.9% YoY.
competition_notes: Chinese competitors are gaining on cost. Leaderdrive (Shanghai-listed) grew 2025 revenue 47% to CNY 570.7m with net profit CNY 124.4m; JPMorgan estimates its China strain-wave market share at 30-40%; 74% of its revenue is robotics/humanoid components and customers reportedly include UBTech and Agibot, with small R&D orders from Figure AI. Nabtesco has entered the small-to-mid-size reducer segment. HDS's China sales subsidiary revenue fell 17.9% YoY in Q1 FY3/27, which fits share pressure in China. HDS's basic patents have expired.
key_drivers: Record orders: Q1 FY3/27 JPY 24.1bn (+55.7% YoY, +37.0% QoQ); book-to-bill 1.45
Operating leverage: OP margin 11.0% vs 0.9% a year earlier; FY guide 11.4% vs 4.3% in FY3/26
Demand from industrial robots and semiconductor equipment across all main applications (company); JARA robot orders +40% YoY in Apr-Jun 2026
Possible guidance raise at H1 results (mid-November) given orders running ahead of sales
Humanoid/AI-robot adoption: each humanoid uses many more reducers than an industrial robot
2030 targets: sales above JPY 100bn and OP margin above 15%
key_risks: Valuation: about 80x forward P/E, 5.9x P/B, 30x EV/EBITDA (our estimates)
Humanoid timeline slippage: MTP already revised for slower AI-robot adoption; JPMorgan sees Tesla Optimus ramp as cautious
Low-cost Chinese reducers (Leaderdrive and others) and Nabtesco in small/mid-size
Cyclicality of robot and semiconductor-equipment capex; FY3/26 OP margin was only 4.3%
Very high volatility: daily moves of 10% or more several times since July 2026
Controlling shareholder structure (company discloses an unlisted parent company)

notes: Price is the Oct 26, 2026 close (night PTS 5,250). Shares exclude 1.65m treasury shares (Jun 30, 2026); Yahoo Japan's JPY 490bn market cap uses issued shares. USD conversion at JPY 156.91/USD. Quarterly orders are read from a garbled chart and mapped by matching totals: FY3/26 quarters 15,501 / 14,018 / 14,476 / 17,617 (JPY m) sum to the reported 61,613; Q1 FY3/27 24,128. Balance sheet as of Jun 30, 2026: cash 22.07 + securities 0.09; debt = borrowings 12.25 + leases 4.64. FCF = operating CF 6.43 less PP&E purchases 5.69. FY3/26 R&D not found (FY3/27 plan JPY 4.0bn; Q1 JPY 0.93bn). Geo mix is our estimate from Q1 subsidiary sales (Harmonic Drive SE = Europe, US subsidiary = Americas, Shanghai sales subsidiary = China); the remaining 48% is parent and Japanese subsidiaries, covering Japan plus direct exports to the rest of Asia, and subsidiary figures likely run on a 3-month lag. The industrial-robot share (29.5%) assumes the first series in the garbled application chart is industrial robots (Q1 FY3/27 value 4,920 of 16,681); low confidence. pe_forward = 5,090 / company EPS 63.38 (Yahoo Japan 80.31x); pb from Yahoo Japan; ev_ebitda_forward is ours = (market cap + debt - cash) / (OP 8.5 + D&A 7.1). FX sensitivity is our inference from the Q1 FX effect. MTP numeric targets come from a FilingReader AI summary; the company notice itself did not list them in the text retrieved.
